artists.biography:
Ugly Kid Joe is an American rock band from Isla Vista, California, formed in 1990. The band's name spoofs that of another band, Pretty Boy Floyd. Ugly Kid Joe's sound includes a range of styles, including hard rock, funk metal and heavy metal.
To date, Ugly Kid Joe has released three full-length albums, two compilation albums and two EPs. Their best selling records are As Ugly as They Wanna Be (1991) and America's Least Wanted (1992), which were both certified double platinum by the RIAA; the former is notable for being the first EP to go platinum. The band broke up in 1997, but announced a reunion in 2010.

perplexity.description:
Menace to Sobriety is Ugly Kid Joe’s second full-length album, originally released in 1995; it presents a noticeably heavier, darker hard‑rock sound that pushed the band away from the more overtly humorous, funk‑tinged blend of their early work toward a muscular, riff‑driven approach. The record's style emphasizes thicker guitar tones, aggressive rhythms and more serious lyrical themes while retaining occasional melodic hooks and the band’s wry sensibility, making it a stylistic bridge between the commercial rock of America’s Least Wanted and the even heavier directions the group explored on subsequent releases.

In the band’s discography Menace to Sobriety occupies a turning‑point role as their second studio LP and follow‑up to their 1992 breakthrough, marking Ugly Kid Joe’s move into darker, more hard‑edged territory; it was issued in 1995 on Mercury (and later associated reissues have appeared on DEKO/DEKO Entertainment). Critically the album received mixed-to-positive attention—some outlets (for example Kerrang!) praised it highly at the time—while commercially it did not match the multi‑platinum success of their debut, a situation the band attributed in part to limited label support in the U.S..
